title: Triton Matmul from Scratch
blurb: Learn how a GPU matmul kernel is organised: program ids, masked block loads, memory traffic, the roofline, and a fused epilogue.
intro: A Triton matmul assigns each program an output tile, loops over K loading masked blocks, accumulates in registers and stores once. The steps cover grouped program ordering for cache reuse, pointer offsets and masks for edge blocks, the global memory traffic a tiling implies, arithmetic intensity on the roofline, and a fused matmul, bias and ReLU kernel. The capstone simulates the whole kernel in NumPy, checks it against a reference, counts its bytes and places it on the roofline.
